basic_info.description: Bright and airy 3-bedroom, 2-bathroom remodeled unit with great city views in the highly sought-after North Bernal Heights neighborhood. This well-maintained 3 unit property, 2 units in the front building and 1 separate cottage unit, have undergone substantial upgrades.  Make your way inside to find pristine hardwood floors, a modern open-plan kitchen and living area, with new countertops and remodeled bathrooms. Natural light fills the space, creating a warm and inviting atmosphere. A small private and a large shared deck provides the perfect outdoor retreat for entertaining or relaxing. Enjoy unbeatable access to green spaces. Precita Park is right around the corner, and Bernal Heights Park just up the hill, offering breathtaking panoramic city views. With easy freeway and public transit access, commuting is a breeze.
